breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and Periodic). The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet boundary condition ('Use Dirichlet boundary conditions with u=0 on all four boundary edges of the spatial domain.'), which matches the ground truth.
